content: वै €1 <ab>P.</ab> (वायति) .²1 To dry, be dried. .²2 To be languid or weary, be exhausted.

वै {%ind.%} A particle of affirmation or certainty (indeed, truly, forsooth), but it is generally used as an expletive; आपो वै नरसूनवः <ls>Ms. 1. 10</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">2. 231</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">9. 49</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">11. 78</ls> <ab>&c.</ab> It is also said to be a vocative particle, and sometimes shows entreaty or persuasion (अनुनय).
